comment: This guitar-based pop-rockish love anthem expresses that feeling of romance while rocketing up the charts of any territory.
Out-of-the-box, shake your head sideways type pop, just like it has always been played. Fits right in with that eye covering fringe and the smart fishbone suit.
Soundtrack to the local shit-faced singles bar. Throw up or pick up and if I pass out, pour the booze over me.
Clean-shaven harmonies and well-mannered lyrics make this tune a true mother-in-law's dream. Ideal for sports intermissions and presidential inauguration parties.
Power ballad in the put-your-lighters-up-genre. You've got a heart of stone if this one doesn't put a tear in your eye.
Warped out space rock that will never exhale. These heavy chords go on forever unchanging, carrying on a great tradition of music that puts unwashed hair above musical ingenuity.
Electronic sounds for the narcissist millennium dandy. Never dance and never go to bed but always look stunning.
Viking helmets, blood and honour go well with this manly celebration of ancient heroes. Battle axe beats carry you off to a time when women were women and men were warriors.
Music for people who don't like music  a love ballad with a message that everyone can agree with and a beat that even your grandma will enjoy.
Top-of-the-lungs punk rock where the volume is more important than the message. Hooligan-style sounds that feed on beer and urban despair.
Powered with all the anger and hate of today's ignored youth, this track is the light that makes schools go up in flames and parents divorce.
Severely tattooed funk-o-metal for the guitar aficionado. This is the real deal, no faking or sampling  only for bands who can really play.
A tribute to the goddess of Rock 'n' Roll. Or whatever. This is for all you long-haired spandex fans out there.
Carrying all the weight of modern society's sins and faults, this happy-clappy song tries to make it all right again. Nauseously naïve and completely charming.
Stadium style groovy cock rock with a kick ass beat and corny lyrics. Never mind the finer aspects of music making, this track will have the drunkest bloke in the pub singing along.
Heart-breaking ballad presenting the essence of the outsider experience. We have all been there, not being allowed to be with the ones we admire, and this song says it all.
Don't let the beauty of the song fool you, this is a sad, sad story of solitude and a love lost. This heart is so broken it makes you want to puke.
Irresistible left-of-the-middle guitar based pop. With the right band this track could be cross over hit, attracting both the early adopters and the mainstream audience.
Straight from the source of groovy Rock 'n' Roll, this track aims for the crotch and hits you in the hips sending you gyrating through the night.
Radical, yet joyous, popish punk with a ska-influenced backbeat and message spelled out in capital letters: Don't eat your friends.
Perfect
